name: frostling_archer
description: a Frostling Archer (Fall from Heaven), a small crouching ice goblin with pale icy-blue skin, long pointed ears poking out of a white fur hood and hung with small icicles, a long hooked nose and a toothy grin, a ragged white-and-grey fur tunic with a brown strap, blue fur-wrapped legs and dark brown boots, a quiver of icy-blue fletched arrows on his back, and a curved white bone bow bound with blue cord in his LEFT hand, an arrow with a pale-cyan ice-shard head nocked and drawn back by his RIGHT hand
hands: the bone bow stays in his left hand on the screen-right side, held out at arm's length with the arrow pointing right; his right hand on the screen-left side draws the string and arrow back to his chest

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the right hand flung out to the left, still clutching the arrow, the bow arm thrown up and out with the bone bow upright)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the bone bow dipping, the right hand still held out with the arrow

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, bow arm flung up with the bone bow upright, the arrow falling from the right hand
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the bone bow lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, one end of the bone bow resting on the ground at the lower-right, the right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the bone bow slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the fur hood slipping back
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the bone bow lies on the ground at the lower-right; the quiver under his shoulders, a few ice-tipped arrows spilled
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the fur hood stays on
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the bone bow on the ground beside him
